decision: Producer concurrency is reduced to one and the two Sonnet stages in D are serialized. Semantic formulation still precedes categorical extraction, preserving model-first authority ordering. Provider responses are now cached atomically by exact prompt/model fingerprint so successful stages survive later interruption.
limitation: A single failed parallel pair does not prove all parallel Claude CLI use is unsafe; it is sufficient to reject concurrency=2 for this long, expensive controlled run.
